method: Each question draws a pattern from the selected fixed pool and a tonic from MIDI 48-60 (C3-C4), keeping the octave at or below MIDI 72 (C5). Common scales offer major, natural minor, harmonic minor and ascending melodic minor; modes offer Ionian, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Aeolian and Locrian; pentatonic and blues offer major pentatonic, minor pentatonic, major blues and minor blues. Each pool contains only distinct pitch collections. Playback sounds the tonic alone, then the recorded semitone offsets ascending to the octave and descending back to the tonic without repeating the top note; melodic minor deliberately uses its ascending form in both directions. Frequencies use 12-tone equal temperament with A4 = 440 Hz: frequency = 440 x 2^((MIDI - 69)/12). A question does not immediately repeat the previous pattern when another choice is available. Answers match the exact scale identifier; accuracy is correct answers divided by questions asked, rounded to a whole percent. The Web Audio API synthesises every tone locally with a triangle-wave envelope; there are no audio files, microphone input, storage or network requests. This practises relative recognition of a complete pitch collection with tonic context, not absolute pitch, key spelling, harmonic function or intonation.
